_about: Generated by tools/build_rings.py from tools/data/*.json. Do not edit by hand.

rings.name: Mudskipper Point
rings.description: Southern tip of Asgarnia, just south of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon trapdoor and Port Sarim.
poi: Royal Titans (boss, via the Ice Dungeon)
notes: The only fairy ring in Asgarnia.

rings.name: Island SE of Ardougne
rings.description: Small empty island off the coast south-east of Ardougne.
notes: First of the four codes to the Fairy Resistance Hideout: AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

rings.name: Auburn Valley
rings.description: Varlamore's Auburn Valley, just south-east of the town of Auburnvale.
requirements: Quest: Children of the Sun
Unlock: travel to Civitas illa Fortis with Regulus Cento

unlock.label: a Regulus Cento ride to Civitas

rings.name: Avium Savannah
rings.description: Centre of the Avium Savannah hunting plains, south of Civitas illa Fortis.
requirements: Quest: Children of the Sun
Unlock: travel to Civitas illa Fortis with Regulus Cento
poi: Ortus Farm allotments and herb patch
notes: The hardwood patch opens after The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute.

unlock.label: a Regulus Cento ride to Civitas

rings.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
rings.description: Dark cave south of Dorgesh-Kaan, beside its agility course and a tunnel to the Kalphite Lair.
requirements: Quest: Death to the Dorgeshuun
danger: Dark: without a light source you take constant damage from insects
poi: Frog spawn and cave eel fishing
notes: Bring a light source and a tinderbox; antipoison helps.

rings.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
rings.description: Just west of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon entrance, east of Rellekka.

rings.name: Penguins near Miscellania
rings.description: Small penguin island near Miscellania, with no other way on or off.
notes: Last of the four codes to the Fairy Resistance Hideout: AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

rings.name: Necropolis
rings.description: Island by the Necropolis mine in the southern desert; 62 Agility to cross to the city.
requirements: Quest: Beneath Cursed Sands (partial: enter the Necropolis at the start of the quest)
Skill: 62 Agility (boostable) to cross from the island to the Necropolis
danger: Desert heat: bring waterskins or desert clothing

rings.name: Piscatoris Hunter area
rings.description: Piscatoris Hunter area, just east of Kraken Cove and south of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony.

rings.name: Hosidius Vinery
rings.description: Great Kourend, just south of the Hosidius Vinery and north of the Tithe Farm.
requirements: Unlock: visit Great Kourend once
notes: Added 10 January 2024.

unlock.label: a first visit to Great Kourend

rings.name: Feldip Hunter area
rings.description: Feldip Hunter jungle, a short run south-east of the Lemantolly Undri gnome glider.

rings.name: Lighthouse
rings.description: Next to the Lighthouse, north of the Barbarian Outpost across the basalt rocks.
notes: Entering the Lighthouse needs Horror from the Deep.

rings.name: Haunted Woods
rings.description: Haunted Woods between Canifis and Port Phasmatys, just south of the Morytania farming patches.
danger: Aggressive leeches, swamp crabs and feral vampyres
poi: Morytania herb, allotment and flower patches
notes: The Ectophial plus this ring is a quick way onto the fairy ring network.

rings.name: Abyssal Area
rings.description: The Abyssal Area, a single-combat cavern of the Abyss with no Wilderness trip.
danger: Aggressive abyssal leeches, guardians and walkers
notes: The only ways out are this ring or a teleport.
Safer than the Abyss for essence pouches: no Wilderness, no skull, no prayer drain.

rings.name: McGrubor's Wood
rings.description: McGrubor's Wood, west of Seers' Village and north of Hemenster.
notes: Used in the medium Kandarin Diary.

rings.name: Island SW of Mort Myre
rings.description: Island on the River Salve with a 50 Agility shortcut into Mort Myre near the Nature Grotto.
notes: The 50 Agility shortcut is the only way off the island on foot.

rings.name: Kalphite Lair
rings.description: Desert south-west of the Shantay Pass: Kalphite Lair to the north-west, Kalphite Cave to the north-east.
danger: Desert heat: bring waterskins or desert clothing
notes: Bring two ropes: one for the Lair entrance and one for the Queen's chamber (not needed once the hard Desert Diary is done).

rings.name: Ardougne Zoo unicorns
rings.description: Inside the unicorn pen at the Ardougne Zoo, in East Ardougne.
notes: The pen has no other way in or out.

rings.name: Isle of Souls
rings.description: Northern coast of the Isle of Souls, home of the Soul Wars minigame.
notes: Added 18 May 2022.

rings.name: Fisher Realm
rings.description: Northern side of the Fisher Realm, the Fisher King's land from Holy Grail.
requirements: Quest: Holy Grail (partial: BJR opens part-way through the quest)
notes: Blow a magic whistle here to come out by the Brimhaven mine.

unlock.label: Holy Grail up to Sir Percival

rings.name: Zul-Andra
rings.description: Small island just west of Zul-Andra, the village where you board the boat to Zulrah.
requirements: Quest: Regicide
Skill: 76 Agility to jump from the island to Zul-Andra
notes: Without 76 Agility, use a Zul-andra teleport scroll instead.

rings.name: South of Castle Wars
rings.description: Chompy Marsh in the Feldip Hills, south of Castle Wars and beside the Smoke Devil Dungeon.

rings.name: Enchanted Valley
rings.description: Hidden realm behind a waterfall, reachable only by fairy ring.
notes: Chopping, fishing or mining here spawns the old random-event guardians.

rings.name: Mort Myre Swamp
rings.description: Northern Mort Myre Swamp, south of Canifis.
danger: Ghasts rot your food; swamp decay (both stop once the Fire of Dehumidification is built)

rings.name: Zanaris
rings.description: Main fairy ring of Zanaris, the Lost City of the fairies.
notes: The Zanaris option on any fairy ring also lands here.

rings.name: Mor Ul Rek (TzHaar City)
rings.description: Outer area of Mor Ul Rek, the TzHaar city under the Karamja volcano.
notes: The inner city (Inferno, TzHaar-Ket-Rak) opens after you show a fire cape once.

rings.name: Yu'biusk
rings.description: Yu'biusk, the shattered goblin homeworld from Land of the Goblins.
requirements: Quest: Land of the Goblins
notes: The ring here is a portal.

rings.name: Legends' Guild
rings.description: Just east of the Legends' Guild entrance, north of Witchaven.

rings.name: Mount Quidamortem
rings.description: Kebos Lowlands south of Mount Quidamortem, near the Chambers of Xeric and the Stranglewood rowboat.
notes: Once you have climbed the mountain and spoken to the Mountain Guide at the summit, the guide south-west of this ring can take you up.
Like the other Kourend rings, it may need a first visit to Great Kourend.

rings.name: Miscellania
rings.description: North-west Miscellania near the castle, with Etceteria and its farming patches to the east.
requirements: Quest: The Fremennik Trials

rings.name: North-west of Yanille
rings.description: Just outside Yanille's west entrance, south of Tree Gnome Village.

rings.name: Mount Karuulm
rings.description: Foot of Mount Karuulm in the Kebos Lowlands, north-east of the Farming Guild.
requirements: Unlock: visit Great Kourend once
notes: Inside the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon you need boots of stone, brimstone or granite boots.

unlock.label: a first visit to Great Kourend

rings.name: Arceuus Library
rings.description: Just north of the Arceuus Library in Great Kourend.
requirements: Unlock: visit Great Kourend once
notes: Before 10 January 2024 this ring needed a dead mushroom ring revived.

unlock.label: a first visit to Great Kourend

rings.name: The Great Conch
rings.description: The Great Conch, the Tortugans' island in the Unquiet Ocean south of Menaphos.
requirements: Quest: Troubled Tortugans (partial: CJQ unlocks when you first reach the Great Conch)
Skill: 51 Slayer, 48 Construction, 45 Sailing, 45 Hunter, 40 Woodcutting, 34 Crafting (none boostable) to start Troubled Tortugans
Quest: Pandemonium (to start Troubled Tortugans)
notes: Added with Sailing (usable from 19 November 2025).

rings.name: Sinclair Mansion
rings.description: Just west of the Sinclair Mansion, north of Camelot and Seers' Village.
poi: Agility shortcut to the Fremennik Province (48 Agility)

rings.name: Cosmic entity's plane
rings.description: The Cosmic entity's plane, where starflowers grow; reachable only by fairy ring.

rings.name: Aldarin
rings.description: Aldarin, the island town off south-west Varlamore, home of Mastering Mixology.
requirements: Quest: Children of the Sun
Unlock: travel to Civitas illa Fortis with Regulus Cento
notes: Added 25 September 2024.

unlock.label: a Regulus Cento ride to Civitas

rings.name: South of Tai Bwo Wannai
rings.description: Karamja jungle south of Tai Bwo Wannai, north-west of Shilo Village.
notes: With 79 Agility (and Shilo Village done), the rocks by the Nature Altar, east of the ring, lead into Shilo Village.

rings.name: Canifis
rings.description: Just west of Canifis, south of the Morytania Slayer Tower.
poi: Grotesque Guardians (tower roof; 75 Slayer, brittle key)

rings.name: Island south of Draynor
rings.description: Small wooded island off the coast of Draynor Village.

rings.name: Ape Atoll
rings.description: Midway along the Ape Atoll Agility Course, just south of Marim.
requirements: Quest: Monkey Madness I
Unlock: Daero's training after Monkey Madness I
notes: To go on to Marim you need a ninja or Kruk greegree and 48 Agility; otherwise take the slow route over the rope bridge.

rings.name: Hazelmere's home
rings.description: Behind Hazelmere's house on the Yanille Chain islands east of Yanille.

rings.name: Abyssal Nexus
rings.description: The Abyssal Nexus, home of the Abyssal Sire, reached safely without the Wilderness.
notes: The appendage north of the Overseer teleports you to Lumbridge.

rings.name: Player-owned house
rings.description: The fairy ring in your own house's superior garden, if you have built one.
requirements: Skill: 85 Construction (boostable) to build the ring in a superior garden
Quest: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen (to buy the fairy enchantment)
poi: Your pool, altar and portals (if built)
notes: The code does nothing unless you have a fairy ring (or Spiritual Fairy Tree) built.

unlock.label: a fairy ring in your house

rings.name: Gorak Plane
rings.description: A small plane full of Goraks, reachable only by fairy ring.
danger: Goraks turn aggressive once you leave the ring; their hits drain your stats

rings.name: Wizards' Tower
rings.description: Just south of the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village.

rings.name: Tower of Life
rings.description: Beside the Tower of Life, between East Ardougne and Port Khazard.

rings.name: Chasm of Fire
rings.description: Just south-east of the Chasm of Fire, in north-west Shayzien.
requirements: Unlock: visit Great Kourend once
poi: Yama (boss, bottom of the Chasm; after A Kingdom Divided)
notes: A Shayzien bank chest is about 29 tiles away.

unlock.label: a first visit to Great Kourend

rings.name: South of Musa Point
rings.description: Karamja's north-east coast south of Musa Point, by the karambwan fishing spots.
notes: The gnome glider here is crashed; the working Karamja glider (Gandius, by the Shipyard) is about 160 tiles south.

rings.name: Edgeville / Grand Exchange
rings.description: Between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange, just east of Krystilia and south of the Wilderness.
notes: Outside the Wilderness, but the ditch is only a short walk north.

rings.name: Polar Hunter area
rings.description: Polar Hunter area east of Rellekka, right beside the cave to Keldagrim.

rings.name: Grimstone Dungeon
rings.description: Inside the Grimstone Dungeon, under the frozen Sailing island of Grimstone north of Weiss.
requirements: Unlock: moor at Grimstone once (87 Sailing, not boostable; an eternal brazier for the icy seas)
danger: Chilled jellies just north and west of the ring; frost dragons deeper in
notes: No cannons in the dungeon.
Added with Sailing (usable from 19 November 2025).

rings.name: North of Nardah
rings.description: Desert north of Nardah, among the desert lizards.
danger: Desert heat: bring waterskins or desert clothing

rings.name: Poison Waste island
rings.description: Island in the Poison Waste south of Isafdar, with a telescope for watching Zulrah fights.
notes: Second of the four codes to the Fairy Resistance Hideout: AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

rings.name: Myreque Hideout (Hollows)
rings.description: Caves under Mort Myre between the Hollows and Canifis, beside the old Myreque hideout.
requirements: Quest: In Search of the Myreque
poi: Cave route towards Mort'ton and Barrows
notes: Tunnels lead from the ring cave to the main cave, which exits at the Hollows and into the Canifis pub cellar.

rings.name: Fairy Resistance Hideout
rings.description: The Fairy Queen's secret hideout, reached by dialling AIR, DLR, DJQ then AJS.
requirements: Quest: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen (started)
Item: Nuff's certificate in your inventory until the quest is complete
notes: DJQ on its own goes nowhere; dial AJS straight after it.
Once used, the sequence appears at the bottom of the travel log.

rings.name: Exit to Al Kharid
rings.description: One-way ring in the Zanaris market that takes you to just behind Al Kharid bank.
requirements: Quest: Lost City (to enter Zanaris)
notes: No staff or fairy ring unlock needed; it only goes to Al Kharid.

rings.name: Exit to Lumbridge Swamp
rings.description: One-way ring near the Chicken Shrine in Zanaris that takes you to the Lumbridge Swamp shed.
requirements: Quest: Lost City (to enter Zanaris)
notes: No staff or fairy ring unlock needed; it only goes to the Lumbridge Swamp.

requirements: Members only
Quest: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen (partial: until the Fairy Godfather lets you use the rings; its skill requirements are not needed)
Quest: Fairytale I - Growing Pains, plus Lost City, Nature Spirit, Priest in Peril and The Restless Ghost
Item: wield a Dramen staff or Lunar staff, unless the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary is complete

portals.label: Myreque Hideout
portals.description: Wooden doors behind the hollow tree in the Hollows (the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub also leads in); needs In Search of the Myreque.

portals.label: Mor Ul Rek
portals.description: Climb down the rocks at the top of the Karamja volcano, then take the cave entrance to Mor Ul Rek.

portals.label: Zanaris
portals.description: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp shed while wielding a Dramen or Lunar staff (or with the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary).
